question: Operation Flood is associated with:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Milk.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

**Operation Flood:**

__
 
• **Operation Flood **was** **initiated in** 1970 **and** **has aided **dairy farmers **in taking charge of their own development and claiming ownership of the resources they produce.
 
• The aims of Operation Flood were as follows:
 
 
• A surge in milk production ("flood of milk");
 
• To boost rural incomes and;
 
• Provide consumers with cheap prices.
 
 
 
• **India's National Milk Grid **connects **milk producers** **with customers **in more than 700 towns and cities, minimising seasonal and regional price differences while ensuring that the producer always obtains fair market pricing in an open and transparent manner.
 
• **Village milk producer cooperatives**, which purchase milk, offer inputs and services and give members access to contemporary management and technology. This served as the cornerstone around which Operation Flood was built.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

Operation Flood: 

The implementation of **Operation Flood** was carried out in three phases:

 
• **Phase I:**

 
 
• Operation Flood's first phase connected 18 of India's **best milk sheds **with customers in the country's four largest cities: **Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, **and **Chennai.**
 
 
 
• **Phase II:**
 
 
• The milk sheds in Operation Flood's Phase II (1981–1985) climbed from **18 to 136,** and the number of milk outlets increased to **290 urban markets**.
 
• A self-sustaining network of **43,000 village cooperatives** serving **4.25 million milk producers** had been established by the end of 1985.
 
 
 
• **Phase III:**
 
 
• ​From **1985 to 1996,** Phase III allowed dairy cooperatives to develop and expand the **infrastructure **needed to obtain and distribute **rising milk volumes. **
 
• For cooperative members, services for feed, artificial insemination, and veterinary first aid were expanded, and **member education **was **enhanced**.
